I clicked Save link, and yes — this is exactly what I was hoping for. The bookmark came back with a real title ("JavaScript | MDN"), the site it's from, and a short description of the page, instead of just a bare address. That's the auto-fill I wanted, so I can actually recognize what I saved later.

And the layout feels right too: the save box up top, and saved links showing as tidy cards underneath. That's a pleasant way to skim them.

This part works well for me. I'll be curious later about clicking a card to open the real page, tagging, and searching — but for what you asked me to check here, the save-and-recognize piece is good.
